title: The Insane Story Behind the Lexus LFA
description:
It started in a bar in Hokkaido, with a question over drinks. It ended with five hundred cars, a loom with almost no equal, and the death of the man who had guided how the car drove. Every year, the project was on Toyota's list of things to be cancelled. Every year, someone saved it. This is the story behind the Lexus LFA, and it is stranger than the car. Here is the twist. The man who made the decision that defined the car, switching from aluminium to carbon fibre, was told by outside engineers that the timeline was insane. They would have budgeted about ten years. Toyota gave itself one. And the story has a human cost that the car's price tag never shows. We will tell it as the sources do, and say where they disagree.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
